note: NRS 449.0027/.0028/.0045 license CHW "pools" as FACILITIES (business entities), not individual CHWs. No separate NV statute creates an individual CHW license/certification/registration -- checked Ch.439 (Admin. of Public Health) and Ch.432/433/632/422, none codify one. The only individual certification is issued by the Nevada Certification Board, a private 501(c)(3) nonprofit (CASAT/UNR) -- not a state board, not created by statute. 2021 AB191/SB420 and 2023 SB117 only authorized Medicaid reimbursement conditioned on that private certification; they did not enact licensure.
